meta.name: research
meta.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调研问题并生成 Markdown 笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速调研并整理成文档
copy.tagline_en: Research a topic and save findings as Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly research and document findings

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会启动一个后台代理，帮你查阅官方文档、源代码等一手资料，然后把研究结果整理成 Markdown 文件保存到仓库中。
howto.when: 当你需要调查某个问题、收集文档或 API 信息，或者想委托后台代理完成阅读任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下 Python 的 asyncio 库的官方用法。
say.note: Claude 会启动后台代理查阅官方文档并生成笔记。

say.text: 查一下 OpenAI API 的最新定价信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will spin up a background agent to consult primary sources like official docs and source code, then save the findings as a Markdown file in the repo.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.

say_en.text: Research the official usage of Python's asyncio library.
Look up the latest pricing for the OpenAI API.
say_en.note: The background agent will fetch data from official sources and save as Markdown.
